messages.subject: residuals error
parts:
I'm trying to get the LD-x2 residuals. Here's my code:

uniLDeval <- mirt(use_dat[,remaining_vDIF], 1,itemtype="graded",verbose=T,quadpts=81,technical=list(NCYCLES=5000)) #converges on 1233
LDresid <- residuals(uniLDeval,type="LD",digits=3,suppress=3,verbose=T)

After the residuals line, I get this error:
Error in if (s == 0) s <- 1 : missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

What is the problem? Thanks for your help,
Aaron
